items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context; the mention of Milt Gabler is made entirely by the interviewer.

ctx.x: bit, sessions like that... When they start appearing? Like, when did musicians get together for sessions and stuff?

Well, Milt Gabler used to have them. But he'd hire guys, you know. But now and then, extra guys would come and sit in, too. This would be on Sunday afternoons. Milt Gabler was one of the instigators of the first....those kind of things.
